$comment: Launch contract for host-launched single-image deployments. studio-console reads this to build the `docker run` invocation for `launch-full` (shapes.full) and `launch-core` (shapes.core). studio-app (this repo) is the sole authority; console must not hardcode entrypoint assumptions. Source of truth: Dockerfile.full + Dockerfile (core) + api/docker/entrypoint.sh. Bump manifest_version on any breaking change to required_env, ports, or volume.

engine.description: Database engine pin, shared across all shapes (full/core/split). The Full image build is the forcing function: whatever Dockerfile.full bundles, split/core compose must match. studio-console reads `image` to pin its postgres service. Single source of truth for these values: api/tests/unit/contracts/test_unit_contracts__postgres_version.py; this block is asserted equal to it by that guard.

full.summary: Self-contained image: nginx front door + PostgreSQL + API + UI + general/transfer workers under supervisord. No external Postgres. Host-launchable.

ports.name: nginx
ports.description: Single front-door origin. nginx routes /api,/ws → API and / → UI. Publish this port; point cloudflared and external proxies here. Listen port follows SHS_NGINX_PORT (default 80).

ports.name: api
ports.description: API process behind nginx. Not host-facing; reachable only via nginx /api,/ws routes.

ports.name: ui
ports.description: UI process behind nginx. Not host-facing; reachable only via nginx /.

volumes.description: Persistent state: generated .env (secrets), Postgres data dir (/workspace/db), and org file storage. Must persist across container restarts. Suggested host default: ~/.studio.

required_env.name: SHS_SUPERVISOR_USER
required_env.description: Username for the supervisord web/control auth. No default; entrypoint exits non-zero if unset.

required_env.name: SHS_SUPERVISOR_PASSWORD
required_env.description: Password for supervisord auth. No default; entrypoint exits non-zero if unset. Fail-closed by design (no auto-generation).

required_env_persistence.description: The required_env pair is checked on EVERY supervisord boot from process env only (entrypoint.sh step 4, outside the first-boot .env-absent block) and is NOT written to /workspace/.env. The container does not remember them. The launcher owns persistence: store them in console state and re-inject via `docker run -e` on every start/restart. Reading them back from the mounted /workspace/.env will NOT work - they are never there. Override-CMD invocations (studio-console/psql/bash) short-circuit before the check and do not need these set.

optional_env.name: SHS_NGINX_PORT
optional_env.description: Host/listen port for the nginx front door - the single origin browser, SSR, and cloudflared all use. nginx routes /api,/ws → API and / → UI internally. Publish this port; the API (8000) and UI (3000) are not host-facing.

optional_env.name: SHS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
optional_env.description: Public URL the deployment is reachable at - the nginx origin. First boot writes http://localhost:${SHS_NGINX_PORT} (default :80) as a placeholder; operator tightens it via the in-container console once the domain is known.

optional_env.name: SHS_CORS_ORIGINS
optional_env.description: Allowed CORS origins. First boot writes '*' (permissive). Once a real domain is set, nginx makes browser/API same-origin so CORS is effectively moot; tighten post-launch regardless.

optional_env.name: SHS_PUBLIC_API_URL
optional_env.description: Browser-bundle API origin. ui-start.sh reads this from /workspace/.env to render __env.js (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL). The entrypoint writes it on first boot honoring a launcher-injected value (non-interactive provisioning), else the nginx-origin placeholder. First-boot-only: do NOT inject on relaunch (clobbers a wizard-set domain). Distinct from SHS_API_BASE_URL, which is SSR-only and stays on the in-container API.

optional_env.name: SHS_WS_URL
optional_env.description: Browser-bundle WebSocket origin (NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL). Same first-boot/never-clobber persistence as SHS_PUBLIC_API_URL.

optional_env.name: SHS_FRONTEND_URL
optional_env.description: Browser-bundle frontend origin (NEXT_PUBLIC_FRONTEND_URL). Same first-boot/never-clobber persistence as SHS_PUBLIC_API_URL.

self_generated_secrets.description: Generated and persisted by the entrypoint on first boot ONLY when /workspace/.env is absent. The operator never supplies these; the launcher must NOT prompt for or set them. Written to /workspace/.env at 0600 and never regenerated on subsequent boots.

consumed_secret_files.description: High-value secrets the launcher supplies via a read-only bind-mounted file instead of `docker run -e` (which leaks via `docker inspect` and /proc/1/environ). The entrypoint reads the file on every boot, upserts the value into /workspace/.env (strip-then-append, 0600), and the launcher removes the host file after `docker run` returns. Drop the file ONLY on first-provision or explicit reconfigure - NEVER on a bare relaunch: a bare relaunch mounts nothing, the entrypoint leaves .env untouched (clobber-protection), and re-dropping a new value rotates it. Distinct from self_generated_secrets (which the launcher must NOT supply) and required_env (injected via -e every boot).

files.format: raw single-line token, surrounding whitespace stripped
files.consumed_on: every boot when the mount is present
files.description: Cloudflare tunnel connector token. Present → cloudflared autostarts on boot (CLOUDFLARED_AUTOSTART=true); absent → cloudflared stays stopped. Enables non-interactive CF provisioning (CI, RunPod, GitOps) without the in-container wizard.

baked_env.description: Set in the image at build time. Operator never tunes these at boot.

entrypoint.first_boot: When /workspace/.env is absent: generate deployment shape + all secrets above + SHS_NGINX_PORT/SHS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL on the nginx origin, write /workspace/.env (0600), init the Postgres data dir at /workspace/db, run bootstrap, then hand off to supervisord (which starts nginx, api, ui, workers).
entrypoint.subsequent_boot: When /workspace/.env exists: use it as-is, generate nothing, start supervisord.
entrypoint.override_cmd: Passing any CMD other than the default supervisord (e.g. `studio-console ...`, `psql`, `bash`) short-circuits first-boot and execs the override directly, after ensuring the .env symlink. Console can run one-off commands in the image without triggering Postgres/supervisord startup.
entrypoint.fail_closed: Exits non-zero if SHS_SUPERVISOR_USER or SHS_SUPERVISOR_PASSWORD is unset, or if SHS_STUDIO_VERSION was not baked into the image.

full.launch_summary: One prompt: SHS_SUPERVISOR_USER + SHS_SUPERVISOR_PASSWORD. Everything else self-generates on first boot.

core.summary: nginx front door + API + UI + general/transfer workers under supervisord. External PostgreSQL, supplied via SHS_DATABASE_URL (BYO Postgres, e.g. a compose sidecar). No in-container database. Host-launchable.

ports.name: nginx
ports.description: Single front-door origin. nginx routes /api,/ws → API and / → UI. Publish this port; point cloudflared and external proxies here. Listen port follows SHS_NGINX_PORT (default 80).

ports.name: api
ports.description: API process behind nginx. Not host-facing; reachable only via nginx /api,/ws routes.

ports.name: ui
ports.description: UI process behind nginx. Not host-facing; reachable only via nginx /.

volumes.description: Persistent state: generated .env (secrets) and org file storage. Unlike full, holds NO Postgres data dir - the database is external. Must persist across container restarts. Suggested host default: ~/.studio.

required_env.name: SHS_SUPERVISOR_USER
required_env.description: Username for the supervisord web/control auth. No default; entrypoint exits non-zero if unset.

required_env.name: SHS_SUPERVISOR_PASSWORD
required_env.description: Password for supervisord auth. No default; entrypoint exits non-zero if unset. Fail-closed by design (no auto-generation).

required_env.name: SHS_DATABASE_URL
required_env.description: Connection URL for the external PostgreSQL (postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@host:5432/db). Core does NOT run or generate a database; the launcher supplies this and owns the Postgres instance. bootstrap.py reads it on first boot. Full generates this itself (in-container DB); core requires it. Point at a Postgres pinned to the manifest `engine` block (pg18 + pgvector 0.8.3).

required_env_persistence.description: None of the required_env keys are written to /workspace/.env. SHS_SUPERVISOR_USER/PASSWORD are checked on every supervisord boot from process env (entrypoint.sh step 4). SHS_DATABASE_URL is read from process env by bootstrap.py and the API; the core first-boot .env block writes only secrets + shape, never DB vars. The launcher owns persistence for all three: store them in console state and re-inject via `docker run -e` on every start/restart. Override-CMD invocations (studio-console/psql/bash) short-circuit before the supervisor check.

optional_env.name: SHS_NGINX_PORT
optional_env.description: Host/listen port for the nginx front door - the single origin browser, SSR, and cloudflared all use. nginx routes /api,/ws → API and / → UI internally. Publish this port; the API (8000) and UI (3000) are not host-facing. Written to /workspace/.env on first boot (default 80) - see self_generated_secrets; the launcher must NOT re-inject it via -e on relaunch (process env beats .env and would clobber an operator-set value).

optional_env.name: SHS_PUBLIC_API_URL
optional_env.description: Browser-bundle API origin. ui-start.sh reads this from /workspace/.env to render __env.js (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL). The entrypoint writes it on first boot honoring a launcher-injected value (non-interactive provisioning), else the nginx-origin placeholder. First-boot-only: do NOT inject on relaunch (clobbers a wizard-set domain). Distinct from SHS_API_BASE_URL, which is SSR-only and stays on the in-container API.

optional_env.name: SHS_WS_URL
optional_env.description: Browser-bundle WebSocket origin (NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL). Same first-boot/never-clobber persistence as SHS_PUBLIC_API_URL.

optional_env.name: SHS_FRONTEND_URL
optional_env.description: Browser-bundle frontend origin (NEXT_PUBLIC_FRONTEND_URL). Same first-boot/never-clobber persistence as SHS_PUBLIC_API_URL.

self_generated_secrets.description: Written and persisted by the entrypoint on first boot ONLY when /workspace/.env is absent, then never regenerated (0600). The first three are random secrets; the last four are the nginx front-door placeholders (identical to full - core is now symmetric). The operator never supplies these and the launcher must NOT prompt for OR re-inject them via `docker run -e`: process env beats .env, so re-passing e.g. SHS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost on relaunch would clobber a domain the in-container CF wizard saved. Unlike full, core generates NO POSTGRES_PASSWORD and NO SHS_DATABASE_URL - the database is external and supplied via required_env.

consumed_secret_files.description: High-value secrets the launcher supplies via a read-only bind-mounted file instead of `docker run -e` (which leaks via `docker inspect` and /proc/1/environ). The entrypoint reads the file on every boot, upserts the value into /workspace/.env (strip-then-append, 0600), and the launcher removes the host file after `docker run` returns. Drop the file ONLY on first-provision or explicit reconfigure - NEVER on a bare relaunch: a bare relaunch mounts nothing, the entrypoint leaves .env untouched (clobber-protection), and re-dropping a new value rotates it. Distinct from self_generated_secrets (which the launcher must NOT supply) and required_env (injected via -e every boot).

files.consumed_on: every boot when the mount is present
files.description: Cloudflare tunnel connector token. Present → cloudflared autostarts on boot (CLOUDFLARED_AUTOSTART=true); absent → cloudflared stays stopped. Enables non-interactive CF provisioning (CI, RunPod, GitOps) without the in-container wizard.

baked_env.description: Set in the image at build time. Operator never tunes these at boot.

entrypoint.first_boot: When /workspace/.env is absent: generate deployment shape + the three secrets + the four nginx front-door placeholders (SHS_NGINX_PORT/CORS/PUBLIC_BASE_URL/WORKSPACE_ROOT, same as full), write /workspace/.env (0600), run bootstrap against the external SHS_DATABASE_URL, then hand off to supervisord (which starts nginx, api, ui, workers). No Postgres init - the DB is external.
entrypoint.subsequent_boot: When /workspace/.env exists: use it as-is, generate nothing, start supervisord.
entrypoint.override_cmd: Passing any CMD other than the default supervisord (e.g. `studio-console ...`, `psql`, `bash`) short-circuits first-boot and execs the override directly, after ensuring the .env symlink.
entrypoint.fail_closed: Exits non-zero if SHS_SUPERVISOR_USER or SHS_SUPERVISOR_PASSWORD is unset, or if SHS_STUDIO_VERSION was not baked into the image. bootstrap.py additionally fails if SHS_DATABASE_URL is unreachable.

core.launch_summary: Prompt for SHS_SUPERVISOR_USER + SHS_SUPERVISOR_PASSWORD + SHS_DATABASE_URL (external Postgres). The three app secrets self-generate on first boot.
